365-dias-de-ajedrez.title: 365 días de ajedrez
description: I turned my experience as a chess coach into a platform of my own that brings teaching, study, and training together in one place.

Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, it connects courses and lessons with tools to explore the game in depth: game databases, a move trainer, puzzle solving, and analysis boards. Every user gets the features and permissions of their role: student, teacher, or administrator.

Having everything in one place helps me understand what each student needs, spot learning difficulties, and catch recurring mistakes. Those findings guide both the one-to-one coaching and the continuous improvement of the programme and its content.
I lead the project from product definition and interface design through implementation, turning my academy’s needs into a tailored digital experience.
365-dias-de-ajedrez.stack: Next.js · React · TypeScript · Payload CMS · Prisma · PostgreSQL · Chessground · chessops · Cloudinary · Vitest · Storybook · Vercel

about.title: about me
about.subtitle: UI design · Frontend · Full Stack
about.quote: I don't separate the design of the interface, the code that makes it work and the decision of what is worth building.
paragraphs: I come from UI design and frontend. That is where I learned to solve the visual detail, the accessibility and the behaviour of the interface before moving towards the back end, where today I work with data, authentication and deployment.

Founding 365 Días de Ajedrez forced me to decide with judgement: what to build first, what to leave out and how to communicate it. It also put me in charge of the screen design, the web development and the advertising of the product.
I am looking for a team where I can contribute to the interface without losing sight of the whole product.
